5835.title: [4.155] Pass -sUSE_WEBGPU to Uno WASM heads only on net8.0
5835.body:
On .NET 9+ the WebAssembly block links Dawn's emdawnwebgpu port, whose
library_webgpu.js refuses to link with emsdk's -sUSE_WEBGPU. The Uno
block added that flag unconditionally, so an Uno 6.x WASM app with the
Skia renderer failed to link with "To use Dawn's library_webgpu.js,
disable -sUSE_WEBGPU". Only net8.0 (emsdk 3.1.34) still uses the
built-in WebGPU port, so add the flag only there. Main no longer has the
flag at all (the Uno block went with the Uno 7 move in #5377, and .NET 8
WASM support was dropped).

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
